title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
abstract: arXiv:2611.01926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. translated_title: TAC-CoT：通过交错显式标记实现的工具赋能隐式思维链
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的智能体系统日益与思维链推理相结合，以解决需要准确推理、外部知识和多步深思的任务。然而，显式思维链会带来巨大的生成开销，而隐式思维链——即用紧凑的连续潜在标记替代文本化推理过程——又无法自然地支持智能体工具使用所需的显式通信接口。我们提出了TAC-CoT，这是一个工具赋能的自适应隐式思维链框架，它用紧凑的潜在推理片段替代显式推理轨迹，同时仅为工具调用、观察结果和最终答案保留文本标记。这种交错式设计使智能体无需将每个中间推理步骤言语化即可进行工具使用。在智能体数学与问答基准上的实验表明，TAC-CoT在将准确率提升至多8.8个百分点的同时，将模型前向传递次数减少至多6.8倍。此外，分析显示TAC-CoT改进了工具……
tldr: TAC-CoT提出一种工具赋能的自适应隐式思维链框架，用紧凑的潜在推理片段替代显式推理文本、仅在工具调用、观察与最终答案处保留文本标记，从而在智能体任务上实现准确率最高提升8.8个百分点、前向传递次数最多减少6.8倍。
en_tdlr: TAC-CoT is a tool-empowered adaptive implicit chain-of-thought framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while keeping textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers, improving accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8x on agentic tasks.
